About us

Field-tested since 2002

A Darwin-based wildlife-risk consultancy built on more than 20 years of hands-on work with crocodiles, snakes and the crews who share their habitat.

Practical. Experienced. On site.

Crocodile Safety Australia (CSA) helps government and industry work safely where crocodiles, snakes and other wildlife live. Our approach is practical and experience-driven: we read the site, understand the animals and design controls that fit the way your crew actually works.

We’re trusted by government agencies, mining and resources companies, construction and infrastructure contractors, environmental consultants, wildlife parks and film productions across the Northern Territory, Western Australia and Queensland.
